# PostgreSQL 18 REL_18_6

> Documentation generated from the `REL_18_6` maintenance-release tag of [postgres/postgres](https://github.com/postgres/postgres) and pinned to immutable source commit `724edf9bde9d356724ad384a2e196edc3c9f80f7`.

- [Full documentation](llms-full.txt): Complete normalized corpus for PostgreSQL 18 REL_18_6.
- [Provenance manifest](manifest.json): Release, commit, document count, and generation notes.
- PostgreSQL 18 tracks the highest `REL_18_<minor>` maintenance-release tag; betas and release candidates are ignored.
- DocBook XML sources are assembled from their declared entities and converted without executing the upstream Make, Meson, Perl, or XSLT toolchain.
- Error-code, wait-event, SQL-conformance, key-word, and Meson-target tables the upstream build generates are reproduced from the same checked-in data files.
